evals.prompt: We added a bunch of modules and two new tables. Rebuild the codebase index.
evals.expected_output: Runs the scan, checks drift against MODULE_CATALOG, and updates .claude/CODEBASE_INDEX.md.
expectations: Counts .py files per directory (intelligence, analysis, physics, features, discovery, trading, oracle, ingestion/altdata, ingestion/international)
Compares those counts with the layer counts reported in docs/MODULE_CATALOG.md and flags drift explicitly
Writes or updates .claude/CODEBASE_INDEX.md (function index, schema quick reference, integration map, server ops)
Does not edit CLAUDE.md or .claude/settings.json (the SessionStart hook already loads the index)

evals.prompt: Rebuild the index, but I'm on a laptop with no tailnet access to grid-svr.
evals.expected_output: Handles unreachable ssh steps gracefully rather than fabricating schema or service data.
expectations: Completes the local scan steps (module counts, signatures, catalog drift)
Reports that the DB schema, row counts and service-status steps could not be run because ssh to grid-svr failed
Does not invent table names, row counts or service states
Marks the schema and server sections of the index as stale or unverified instead of silently leaving old data

evals.prompt: Does GRID have a transfer entropy module? Use the orient skill.
evals.expected_output: Misrouted request: existence checks belong to grid-check-exists, which the skill's note says to use.
expectations: Points out that existence checks should use /grid-check-exists <keyword>, per the note in the skill
Does not rebuild the whole index just to answer an existence question
